slot_scores.name: corn_minimum_twice_wheat
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any minimum or maximum acre requirements for any individual crop (corn, wheat, soybeans, or sorghum) beyond the soybeans-at-least-half-of-sorghum rule?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about additional crop acreage requirements, which elicited the corn-at-least-twice-wheat rule, and then confirmed its minimum/exact nature in turn 4.

slot_scores.name: wheat_three_times_sorghum
slot_scores.evidence_quote: Are there any minimum or maximum acre requirements for any individual crop (corn, wheat, soybeans, or sorghum) beyond the soybeans-at-least-half-of-sorghum rule?
slot_scores.rationale: The agent asked about additional crop acreage requirements, which elicited the wheat-three-times-sorghum rule, and then confirmed it is exact in turn 3.

silent_assumptions.agent_assumption: Corn acres must be at least twice wheat acres, and this applies even when wheat is zero.
silent_assumptions.silent_reason: The agent did confirm the minimum relationship in turn 4, but the zero-wheat applicability was only clarified in turn 9; however, the core hidden slot was confirmed, so this is not an unconfirmed hidden-slot assumption.

stopping_behavior.rationale: Both P1 hidden slots were resolved before READY_TO_MODEL; the remaining unresolved integrality issue is not a listed hidden slot and does not block modeling.

summary: The agent successfully recovered both P1 hidden relational constraints through targeted questions and confirmed their exact/minimum nature before stopping. The only unresolved issue was integrality, which was not a hidden slot and was explicitly noted as pending.

restoration_summary.rule: Exact restoration uses only P0/P1 slots; unresolved P2 slots do not affect exact restoration.

stopping_consistency_audit.rule: Any non-yes P0/P1 slot at READY_TO_MODEL is unresolved.
